# LegalZoom

> > LegalZoom provides affordable, online legal solutions for business formation, compliance, intellectual property protection, and personal legal needs, trusted by millions.

LegalZoom is a comprehensive legal services platform offering guided document preparation, business registration, and compliance management. The platform serves entrepreneurs, small business owners, and individuals seeking affordable alternatives to traditional legal counsel.

## Key Topics

- Business Formation
- LLC (Limited Liability Company)
- Corporation Formation
- Trademark Registration
- Business Compliance
- EIN (Federal Tax ID)
- Nonprofit Formation
- DBA Registration
- Intellectual Property Protection
- Business Licenses and Permits
- Annual Reports
- Operating Agreements
- Patent and Copyright Services
- Secretary of State Filing
- Business Credit Building

## Business Formation

- [Business Formation - Choose a Business Structure: LLC, Corporation, Sole Proprietorship, Partnership](https://www.legalzoom.com/business/business-formation): Main business formation hub covering LLC, corporation, and sole proprietorship structure options.
- [Create an LLC Online | Start an LLC for $0 + State Filing Fees](https://www.legalzoom.com/business/business-formation/llc-overview.html): Step-by-step guide to forming an LLC with pricing and service options.
- [Form a Corporation Online](https://www.legalzoom.com/business/business-formation/inc-overview.html): Guide to incorporating a business as S corp or C corp with asset protection benefits.
- [Start a Nonprofit in 3 Easy Steps](https://www.legalzoom.com/business/business-formation/nonprofit-overview.html): Three-step guide to forming a nonprofit and obtaining 501(c)(3) tax-exempt status.
- [Register a DBA Online](https://www.legalzoom.com/business/business-formation/dba-overview.html): Instructions for registering a DBA (Doing Business As) name online.
- [Online Sole Proprietorship Registration](https://www.legalzoom.com/business/business-formation/sole-proprietorship-overview.html): Guide to starting a sole proprietorship and filing a DBA with the state.

## Business Compliance & Operations

- [Explore Business Management Services](https://www.legalzoom.com/business/business-operations): Business operations hub covering compliance, licenses, EINs, and management services.
- [Business Compliance - Expert Support for Your Company](https://www.legalzoom.com/business/business-operations/compliance): Guide to business compliance including annual reports and license management.
- [Get an EIN Online (Federal Tax ID Number)](https://www.legalzoom.com/business/business-operations/ein-federal-tax-identification-overview.html): Instructions for obtaining an EIN/Federal Tax ID Number from the IRS.
- [File an Annual Report with LegalZoom](https://www.legalzoom.com/business/business-operations/annual-report-overview.html): Service overview for filing annual reports to maintain business good standing.
- [Apply for Business Licenses and Permits Online](https://www.legalzoom.com/business/business-operations/business-licenses-overview.html): Guide to obtaining business licenses and permits for regulatory compliance.
- [Get a Custom LLC Operating Agreement Online](https://www.legalzoom.com/business/business-operations/operating-agreement-overview.html): Guide to creating a custom operating agreement for LLC governance.
- [File for an LLC Dissolution Online](https://www.legalzoom.com/business/business-operations/articles-of-dissolution-llc-corporation-overview.html): Guide to filing LLC or corporation dissolution with articles of dissolution.

## Intellectual Property Protection

- [Intellectual Property Protection Online - Trademark and Copyright Registrations, Provisional Patent Application](https://www.legalzoom.com/business/intellectual-property): Intellectual property hub for trademark, copyright, and patent protection services.
- [Register a Trademark: Attorney Guidance at Every Step](https://www.legalzoom.com/business/intellectual-property/trademark-registration-overview.html): Step-by-step guide to trademark registration with attorney support.
- [Conduct a Trademark Search | Protect Your Idea](https://www.legalzoom.com/business/intellectual-property/trademark-search-overview.html): Guide to conducting comprehensive trademark searches across USPTO databases.
- [Free Trademark Search](https://www.legalzoom.com/business/intellectual-property/free-trademark-search): Free tool for checking trademark availability in USPTO database.

## Additional Business Services

- [Virtual mailbox for business](https://www.legalzoom.com/business/business-operations/lz-virtual-mail-overview.html): Service overview for virtual mailbox and business mail management.
- [Build Your Business Credit with CreditLadder](https://www.legalzoom.com/business/business-operations/credit-ladder-overview.html): Guide to building business credit using CreditLadder and Dun & Bradstreet.
